name: Poly Network (LockProxy custody on Ethereum, BSC and Polygon)
release_shares: Ethereum about 45%, BSC about 41%, Polygon about 14% of value; all from LockProxy custody
failure_basis: release-side cross-chain manager executed a relayed message that replaced its keeper key; later releases were signed with the replacement key
outflow_source: onchain: https://etherscan.io/block/12996671 to https://etherscan.io/block/12996843 (data/incidents/onchain/E05_eth.json) ; onchain: https://polygonscan.com/block/17828103 (last Polygon release) ; onchain: https://bscscan.com/block/9906162 to https://bscscan.com/block/9906550 (BSC releases)
pause_what: No pause time found for the bridge itself; dependent services suspended by partners from 12:59 UTC; cross-chain service restored for 59 assets on 2021-08-26
recovered_note: All assets returned 2021-08-11 to 2021-08-23 (the last 141M through a shared multisig key); 33.4M USDT frozen by the issuer on 2021-08-10 and reissued to the operator on 2021-08-25
notes: Keeper-key replacements preceded the releases on each chain (BSC 09:33:07, Ethereum 09:48:40, Polygon 10:04:14 UTC). All-chain span 09:51:02 to 10:29:21 UTC. Per-release amounts on BSC not published; the BSC leg enters the value path as one interval.

name: pNetwork pBTC-on-BSC (BTC custody on Bitcoin)
release_shares: 100% from the BTC custody backing pBTC on BSC
failure_basis: the bridge's off-chain node accepted peg-out event logs emitted by contracts other than the bridge's and released BTC against them
pause_what: Bridges taken offline after detection (time not published); pBTC-on-BSC bridge suspended until further notice (operator post 2021-09-20 11:33 UTC)
recovered_note: SoK (2024) reports the funds still held at the recipient addresses; a 1.5M USD bounty was offered
notes: DefiLlama dates the record 2021-10-04 (publication date of an analysis); the releases were on 2021-09-19. SoK reports the operator detected the event within 13 minutes (internal detection, not public).

name: Qubit QBridge (unbacked xETH mint on BSC)
release_shares: 100% unbacked xETH minted on BSC, realized by borrowing from the operator's BSC lending markets
failure_basis: legacy origin-side deposit path emitted deposit events without locking value; the relayer and the mint honored them
first_alert_by: independent analyst (X post naming the recipient address)
pause_what: Supply, Redeem, Borrow, Repay, Bridge and Bridge redemption disabled; the operator says immediately after the event, without a time; first documented in the post-mortem published 07:32 UTC
recovered_note: Operator report of 2022-01-31: funds still held by the recipient and monitored; operator compensation from 2022-02-22 is reimbursement, not recovery
notes: Borrowing against the minted xETH followed the mints; an independent post at 22:19 UTC already showed about 80M at the recipient address, so the value had left within 43 minutes of the first mint.

name: Wormhole token bridge (Solana mint, Ethereum escrow)
release_shares: mint 120,000 wETH on Solana (100%); 93,750 (78.1%) redeemed against the Ethereum escrow in 3 releases; 26,250 (21.9%) sold on Solana
failure_basis: release-side signature check on Solana trusted an unvalidated account and accepted a forged transfer message
pause_what: guardian network and token bridge taken down 'for maintenance' (time from a summary of the operator's incident report); all releases had ended at 18:33:32 UTC
recovered_note: About 140M (net) seized on 2023-02-21 under a High Court of England and Wales order and moved to an authorised third party; the operator's backer replaced the 120,000 ETH on 2022-02-03 (reimbursement, not counted)
notes: Operator contributors noticed the discrepancy 19:07 to 19:20 UTC (incident-report summary); an operator address sent an on-chain message to the recipient at 20:15:31 UTC, before the first public post.

name: Multichain (Fantom, Moonriver and Dogechain bridge custody on Ethereum)
release_shares: Fantom bridge 94.2%, Moonriver bridge 5.3%, Dogechain bridge 0.5% (Ethereum custody of each)
failure_basis: bridge MPC signing keys used outside the operating team; releases carried valid signatures
outflow_source: onchain: https://etherscan.io/block/17635954 to https://etherscan.io/block/17635954 (data/incidents/onchain/E22_eth_ftm_tests.json) ; onchain: https://etherscan.io/block/17636491 to https://etherscan.io/block/17636924 (data/incidents/onchain/E22_eth_ftm.json) ; onchain: https://etherscan.io/block/17636967 to https://etherscan.io/block/17637000 (data/incidents/onchain/E22_eth_movr.json) ; onchain: https://etherscan.io/block/17637063 to https://etherscan.io/block/17637063 (data/incidents/onchain/E22_eth_doge.json)
first_alert_by: news media (CoinDesk article on unannounced outflows)
pause_what: all cross-chain services stopped, bridge transactions left on source chains (time of the announcement; actual stop time not stated)
recovered_note: none returned; 63.2M USDC frozen by the issuer (2023-07-07) and over 2.5M USDT frozen (2023-07-08) at the recipient addresses
notes: Service had been degraded since late May 2023; the operator ceased operations on 2023-07-14.

name: Mixin Network (deposit addresses and hot wallets backing its ledger)
release_shares: Ethereum ETH 66.9%, Ethereum USDT 16.5%, Bitcoin 16.6% of measured value
failure_basis: keys of deposit addresses and hot wallets obtained by an outside party from a cloud-provider database; plain signed transfers
pause_what: deposits and withdrawals between the ledger and external chains suspended; announced in the first statement, time of effect not given
recovered_note: none reported; the operator posted an on-chain bounty offer on 2023-09-24 and said at least half of user assets would be covered from its own resources (reimbursement)
notes: Scope is a judgment: custody of deposits that back balances on the network's own ledger (a custodial peg; SoK Table 8 lists it, DefiLlama does not flag it). Outflows ran from the highest to the lowest balance.

name: HECO Chain bridge (Ethereum custody)
release_shares: 100% from the Ethereum custody contract
failure_basis: bridge operator keys used by an unauthorized party; releases carried valid two-operator confirmations
ack_channel: X post by the operator's owner
pause_what: no pause of the bridge contract found (no Paused event through block 19,500,000); a ninth operator call reverted at 10:22:47 UTC; the affiliated exchange stopped withdrawals about 11:26 UTC
recovered_note: none reported; the owner promised to compensate affected users (reimbursement)
notes: Same-day outflows from the affiliated exchange's hot wallets are not counted.

name: Force Bridge (Nervos; Ethereum and BSC lock contracts)
release_shares: Ethereum lock contract 3.13M (83%), BSC lock contract 0.63M (17%)
failure_basis: admin-level unlock functions called with keys under outside control; no code flaw reported
pause_what: bridge service paused, announced in the first statement after all four releases
recovered_note: none reported
notes: The bridge was in its announced wind-down period (withdrawals open 2025-06-01 to 2025-11-30). Failed attempts preceded the releases over about six hours (Halborn).

name: ZKSwap rollup bridge (Ethereum L1 contract, exit mode)
release_shares: 100% from the Ethereum L1 contract
failure_basis: deployed exit-proof verifier accepted any proof in exit mode
recovered_note: none reported
notes: No operator statement found. The rollup had stopped normal operation in February 2025; exit mode was triggered at 13:13:35 UTC and false exit entries recorded at 14:22:47 UTC.

name: Shibarium bridge (Ethereum predicates)
release_shares: 100% from the Ethereum-side predicates
failure_basis: 10 of 12 validator signing keys under outside control; a false checkpoint was signed
ack_channel: X post by the lead developer
pause_what: checkpoint layer halted automatically after the false checkpoints; staking and unstaking paused (no clock time found); bridges restarted in phases from about 2025-10-14
limit_in_force: automatic halt of the checkpoint layer on inconsistent checkpoints; no amount limit or withdrawal delay reported before the event
recovered_note: 4.6M BONE bought with borrowed funds was locked by the staking pause and recovered; about 248.9B KNINE blacklisted; Rekt puts the frozen total near 1.3M
notes: After the event a 7-day finalization delay was added to BONE withdrawals.

name: Seedify SFUND token bridge (unbacked mint)
release_shares: about 8.79M SFUND minted; value realized mainly from BSC liquidity
failure_basis: developer key used to change token-bridge settings and mint unbacked tokens
pause_what: all token bridges disabled and permissions revoked; exchanges asked to halt trading (no clock time found)
recovered_note: about 0.2M frozen at an exchange
notes: Start time is the operator's approximate time.

name: GriffinAI GAIN token bridge (unbacked mint on BSC)
release_shares: 5B GAIN minted on BSC; about 147.5M sold for about 2,955 BNB
failure_basis: admin key used to register a counterfeit trusted peer; the token bridge minted on its messages
pause_what: compromised cross-chain connection secured and exchanges asked to halt deposits, withdrawals and trading (no clock time found)
recovered_note: none reported
notes: Sales of the minted tokens followed within about an hour; proceeds left BSC 00:37 to 01:06 UTC on 2025-09-25.

name: Kelp rsETH cross-chain adapter (Ethereum escrow)
release_shares: 100% from the Ethereum-side adapter (balance 116,723 to 223 rsETH)
failure_basis: the single required verifier attested a cross-chain message for which no source-chain send existed; its data feeds were falsified, its signing keys were intact
pause_what: emergency pauser multisig executed pauseAll on the token's configuration contract and related contracts on Ethereum and several L2s; a second verified packet of about 40,000 rsETH then failed to execute twice (18:26 and 18:28 UTC)
recovered_note: 30,766 ETH (about 71.1M) frozen on Arbitrum by that chain's governance council and moved to a wallet it controls on 2026-04-21; release to the recovery effort pending in the sources read
notes: A 1-of-1 verifier configuration had replaced an earlier 2-of-2 configuration.

name: TAC TON-TAC bridge (unbacked mint on TAC, release on TON)
release_shares: unbacked mint on TAC EVM (14 mint transactions), then release of locked assets on TON when minted tokens were bridged back; shares not published
failure_basis: origin-side deposit flow accepted a deposit notice from a counterfeit token wallet; the sequencer minted against it
ack_channel: earliest operator post found (X); press says the operator disclosed on 2026-05-11
pause_what: the whole sequencer set connecting TAC and TON halted; cross-chain transfers restored 2026-06-10
recovered_note: returned by the initiating party on 2026-05-14 under an offer leaving about 10% as a bounty (80.2% of the loss)

name: THORChain (one vault on ten chains)
chains: Ethereum, Bitcoin, Dogecoin, Litecoin, BSC, Avalanche, Bitcoin Cash, Base, XRP, TRON
release_shares: vault custody on the assets' home chains: Ethereum about 49%, Bitcoin 30%, Dogecoin 5%, Litecoin 5%, BSC 4%, Avalanche 3%, other 3% (QuillAudits)
failure_basis: a newly joined node reconstructed a vault's threshold key and signed transfers directly
ack_channel: first official statement in the operator's timeline (channel not named)
pause_what: automatic solvency checker halted protocol signing and trading on six chains within about 52 minutes of the unauthorized transactions; node operators then halted the network (restart 2026-06-22)
limit_in_force: automatic solvency halt (signing and trading stop when more than 66% of nodes report a chain insolvent); outbound delay for large protocol-signed outbounds
recovered_note: none reported; loss absorbed by protocol-owned liquidity (operator funds, not recovery)
notes: Release times measured on Ethereum and Bitcoin (9.3M of 10.7M) plus one Base release; Dogecoin, Litecoin, Bitcoin Cash, XRP, TRON, BSC and Avalanche legs not measured, so the first release may be earlier than 07:24:59 UTC. Ethereum token releases through the protocol router continued after the automatic halt.

name: Verus-Ethereum bridge (Ethereum contract), May 2026
release_shares: 100% from the Ethereum-side bridge reserves
failure_basis: release-side contract misparsed export data and released reserves without a matching valid export
ack_channel: operator statement on Discord, quoted by The Block (article published 02:54 UTC)
pause_what: Verus network halted as block-producing nodes took themselves offline on encountering byproducts of the event (automatic; no time given)
recovered_note: 4,052.4 ETH (about 75%) returned by 2026-05-23 under a public bounty offer; 1,350 ETH kept as bounty; valued at the DefiLlama ETH price of 2026-05-23

name: Wanchain Cardano-BNB Chain bridge (Cardano treasury)
release_shares: 100% from the Cardano-side treasury (about 97.8% of its NIGHT balance)
failure_basis: release validator's signed message lacked field separators, so a valid signature was reused for other releases
pause_what: bridge taken offline (no time given); the treasury still released 14,113 NIGHT to another address at 16:29:14 UTC and shows no transactions from 21:21 UTC until 2026-08-14
recovered_note: none found; a 90/10 settlement offer (deadline 2026-08-06) went unanswered in the sources read
notes: Eight small releases of 1,978 to 7,866 NIGHT to the same recipient between 12:30 and 14:49 UTC are consistent with ordinary signed transfers and are not counted.

name: AFX Trade custody bridge (Arbitrum)
release_shares: 100% from the USDC custody contract on Arbitrum
failure_basis: five of seven validator hot keys (7,142 of 10,000 votes) signed the withdrawal
first_alert_by: Arbitrum co-founder (X post); Blockaid's alert time not established
pause_what: bridge operations suspended off-chain on detection (no time given); no pause event from the contract through 2026-07-26
limit_in_force: 200-second dispute window between withdrawal request and finalization
recovered_note: none reported; a 70/30 settlement offer went unanswered

name: Liquid Network federated peg (Bitcoin reserve)
release_shares: unbacked mint of about 4,000 L-BTC on the sidechain; 3,996.02 BTC (99.9%) redeemed from the federation's Bitcoin reserve in one peg-out
failure_basis: sidechain node software admitted about 4,000 unbacked L-BTC through a proof-verification cache flaw; the federation honored their peg-out burn
pause_what: bridge (peg) nodes halted, pausing peg operations and the sidechain; the federation had kept signing other peg-outs for more than two hours after the reserve fell
limit_in_force: none (only allowlisted peg-out destinations; no size, velocity or delay control)
recovered_note: 3,400 BTC returned to the federation peg wallet on 2026-09-07 at 16:09:25 UTC after a signed on-chain message; about 600 BTC still under recovery
notes: Unbacked issuance on the sidechain at 13:53:10 UTC (block later reorganized away), peg-out request at 14:05 UTC, release at 14:28:56 UTC; the release, not the issuance, is the first release because the issued claims were redeemed. Internal monitoring flagged a block-production stall at 14:10 UTC.

name: Gravity Bridge (Ethereum contract)
release_shares: 100% from the Ethereum contract; each release emptied that token's balance
failure_basis: the counterparty chain registered a fabricated token mapping as the voucher for four escrowed tokens, and validators signed withdrawal batches against it with valid signatures
pause_what: validators and orchestrators halted at the team's request, which stops batch signing (the Ethereum contract has no pause function); the halt height was not readable from pruned nodes; releases resumed 2026-09-23
recovered_note: none reported
notes: DefiLlama files it as a validator key event; the analyses cited find valid validator signatures over a fabricated mapping. The contract kept executing ordinary batches until 10:11:35 UTC.

name: Syscoin UTXO-NEVM bridge (NEVM vault of pre-allocated SYS)
release_shares: one release of 5B native SYS from the NEVM vault's pre-allocated supply (50.3% of its balance), re-locked four minutes later and carried to the UTXO chain
failure_basis: the release-side relay read a burn carrying duplicated asset commitments as a burn of native SYS, while the origin chain recorded it as a burn of a custom asset
pause_what: vault owner set the paused flag on the NEVM vault, blocking releases and new locks (no event; read from the vault's transactions and its paused state); ownership was later renounced with the vault still paused
pause_source: onchain: Syscoin NEVM blocks 934,941 to 934,942 (paused() false then true) ; press: https://rekt.news/syscoin-rekt
recovered_note: 4,999,999,999.9998 SYS returned to the operator's recovery address on 2026-06-10 and burned on 2026-06-15; valued at the DefiLlama SYS price of 2026-06-10
notes: Value is notional: the released quantity far exceeded the circulating supply. The burn the release relied on was confirmed 76 minutes earlier on the UTXO chain.

name: Axelar-Secret connection (unbacked mint on Secret, Axelar escrow)
release_shares: seven unbacked mints on Secret (19:14:05 to 19:20:09 UTC), all redeemed against the Axelar-side escrow for the Secret connection
failure_basis: the Secret-side token contract minted on packets without checking their source channel; the Axelar-side escrow then honored the redemptions
outflow_source: onchain: Axelar heights read from a public node (research batch_L)
ack_channel: X post (@axelar); the Secret forum post is dated the same day
pause_what: Secret connections disabled by the Axelar emergency committee after a routine transfer failed on June 17 (15:39 UTC); on-chain deactivation 2026-06-18 17:47:53 UTC
recovered_note: none returned; about 0.64M to 0.77M stayed unmoved in the recipient's account (not frozen); a non-binding governance signal to freeze it passed on 2026-07-05
notes: The shortfall went unnoticed for seven days. DefiLlama records the same event again as 'Secret Network' on 2026-06-19 (E54).

name: Aztec Connect rollup contract (Ethereum)
release_shares: one transaction emptied the contract's ETH, DAI, wstETH and LUSD balances and its vault-token balances
failure_basis: the L1 rollup contract accepted a proof whose rows its settlement never processed, crediting deposits that did not exist
pause_what: none possible: the contract is immutable and its admin and upgrade roles were renounced in April 2024
recovered_note: none reported
notes: A second address used the same path on June 15 for about 88K of positions with little redeemable value (not counted). The operator identified the event internally at 12:30 UTC.

name: Aztec 2.0 rollup contract (Ethereum, escape-hatch path)
release_shares: three releases took 1,158 of 1,158.76 ETH, 150,000 of 150,095.70 DAI and all renBTC held
failure_basis: the escape-hatch verifier accepted a withdrawal proof not backed by any deposit
pause_what: none possible: the contract is immutable and administrative control was renounced in April 2024
limit_in_force: escape-hatch withdrawals open only in blocks 4,560 to 4,799 of every 4,800-block period (about 48 minutes in every 16 hours); no amount cap
recovered_note: none reported
notes: A separate event from E52 (different contract, verifier and initiating address). A second address swept 0.76 ETH on June 18 (not counted).

name: Taiko bridge (Ethereum-side Bridge and ERC20Vault)
release_shares: token vault: 10 releases emptied most token balances and 1.99M of 110.5M TAIKO; bridge: 25 ETH releases, 277.97 of about 1,285 ETH
failure_basis: a leaked enclave signing key let the initiating party register its own prover instance; L1 accepted the messages that prover attested
outflow_source: onchain: research batch_L release list ; press: https://www.theblock.co/post/405486
pause_what: Paused events on the L1 Bridge and the token vault in one transaction by the DAO controller; the outflow had ended at 02:10:35 UTC when L2 batch proposals on L1 stopped (proposers halted block production)
pause_source: onchain: Paused events of the L1 Bridge and vault (research batch_L) ; press: https://tangem.com/en/news/security/30675-taiko-reopens-bridge-after-1-7m-exploit-users-reimbursed/
limit_in_force: 24-hour quota with linear refill per asset on the L1 bridge and token vault (ETH 1,000; TAIKO 2,000,000; USDC and USDT 4,000,000; WETH 1,000; none for WBTC, crvUSD, CRV, iZi, weETH)
recovered_note: none reported; the operator replenished the bridge and reimbursed users from its treasury (reimbursement)
notes: The only event in the set where a per-period quota visibly shaped the release path of an escrowed asset over hours: after the token balances left at 22:07 to 22:28 UTC, ETH left in about 25 small releases at the refill rate until block production stopped. An 18 ETH release at 23:57:35 UTC to another address through another entry point is not counted.

name: Across relayer fills on invalid Solana deposits (relayer capital)
release_shares: relayer inventory on 18 destination chains: HyperEVM 1.33M, Ethereum 0.84M, Robinhood Chain 0.81M, Base 0.44M, Optimism 0.26M, 13 others 0.82M
failure_basis: the relayer's off-chain event reader accepted fabricated deposit events that no deposit backed and advanced fills against them
release_side_source: press: https://indexer.api.across.to/deposits (fills and prices; research batch_L)
outflow_source: press: https://indexer.api.across.to/deposits (first and last fill per chain)
pause_what: relayer blacklisted the initiating addresses and stopped filling; the remaining 1,046 invalid deposits expired unfilled; Solana routes disabled in the API at 08:23 UTC and the Solana deposit contract paused at 08:35 UTC (both stated)
recovered_note: about 0.5M of the initiating party's funds held inside the protocol offset the loss; users were not affected (the loss was the relayer's capital)
notes: Invalid deposit events ran 05:07:34 to 06:14:33 UTC; the first fill came 3 s after its deposit event. Per-chain values enter the value path as intervals between each chain's first and last fill.

name: Allbridge Core Solana pools (pool accounting)
release_shares: one transaction took 42.2% of the USDC pool vault and 25.5% of the USDT pool vault
failure_basis: a swap accepted one pool account as both sender and receiver, so pool accounting diverged from the vault balances
release_side_source: onchain: Solana pool vault balances (research batch_L)
outflow_source: onchain: Solana block time read from the public RPC (research batch_L)
pause_what: protocol paused, announced in the first statement; no on-chain pause found on the affected pool accounts
recovered_note: none reported
notes: About 200 later swaps and transfers by other addresses through the imbalanced pools (17:53 to 18:30 UTC) are not counted.

name: Poly Network Neo N3 route (Neo N3 payouts, Ethereum lock proxy)
release_shares: unbacked tenfold payouts on Neo N3 from the bridge's pre-allocated supply; redemption against the Ethereum lock proxy (590 WETH, 1,168,460 USDT, 17.6 WBTC, about 3.78M) and BSC (about 0.2M); the rest sold into pools on Neo N3
failure_basis: the Neo N3 cross-chain manager executed each valid inbound message ten times; the excess claims were redeemed against the lock proxies
failure_class_source: postmortem: https://medium.com/flamingo-finance/poly-network-bridge-exploit-and-the-asset-support-initiative-c80c636255bb ; onchain: Neo N3 application logs (research batch_K)
release_side_source: onchain: Ethereum lock-proxy unlock events (research batch_K)
ack_channel: X post by the main application on the route (the bridge operator made no statement)
pause_what: cross-chain service on the Neo N3 route suspended (announced by the application); the Ethereum lock proxy was already empty at 23:55:59 UTC on 08-11
limit_in_force: hot/cold split: the lock proxies held about 20% to 25% of the backing (a stock cap on exposure); per-transaction caps, delays and daily limits announced in December 2023 not shown to be in force
recovered_note: none returned; eight addresses frozen on Neo N3 by its council (amount not stated); the application's compensation programme is reimbursement
notes: A distinct event from E21 (2023) and E05 (2021). The bridge operator terminated all services on 2024-09-30.

name: FEG SmartBridge (custody of the FEG token on Ethereum, Base, BSC)
release_shares: FEG held by the bridge contract on each chain, sold in the same transactions: BSC 47%, Ethereum 30%, Base 23% of proceeds
failure_basis: the bridge relayer accepted messages from an unauthorized source contract that whitelisted the recipient and registered withdrawals
pause_what: the project's protocol suspended and exchanges asked to halt trading (first reported by a third party at 06:49:46 UTC); the bridge was disabled on-chain later (undated)
recovered_note: none reported
notes: The forged messages were registered at 05:02 to 05:03 UTC, about 49 minutes before the releases.

name: Garden (inventory of one independent solver)
release_shares: the solver's own working capital on Base, Ethereum, Arbitrum, Solana and Bitcoin; EVM legs about 3.4M of 11.4M
failure_basis: the solver's private key leaked from a device under outside control; transfers out of its inventory carried valid signatures
outflow_source: onchain: Base, Ethereum and Arbitrum receipts read through public RPC (research batch_K)
pause_what: application taken offline (first post); the solver's EVM balances had been emptied within minutes
recovered_note: none reported
notes: Main chain unknown (Solana and Bitcoin legs not decoded); outflow duration is the span of the EVM releases (12:28:07 to 12:32:17 UTC). Solana activity at the recipient ran 12:28:06 to 12:32:13 UTC.

name: CrossCurve PortalV2 bridge (Ethereum, Arbitrum)
release_shares: portal holdings on Ethereum, then Arbitrum; shares not found
failure_basis: the receiver's express-execution path accepted spoofed cross-chain messages without gateway validation and the portal unlocked tokens
ack_channel: operator statement reported on 2026-02-01 (time not found)
pause_what: backend taken offline and router contracts paused (no time found)
recovered_note: none reported
notes: Release times not established; a search summary of one analysis puts the start near 18:38 UTC on Ethereum (not verified).

name: IoTeX ioTube bridge (Ethereum-side reserves and minter)
release_shares: about 4.4M of real assets left the reserve contract (escrow); 410M to 821M unbacked CIOTX were minted, of which about 86% were frozen or locked
failure_basis: the owner key of the Ethereum-side validator contract was under outside control; the contract was upgraded to skip signature checks and ownership of the reserve and minter contracts was moved
ack_channel: first operator response 79 minutes after the first third-party alert (Rekt); clock time not found
pause_what: bridge operations suspended on all chains pending an audit (start time not given)
limit_in_force: none (no multisig requirement, timelock or circuit breaker on the validator keys)
recovered_note: about 0.25M frozen by exchanges; most unbacked tokens frozen or locked (not part of the 4.4M); the operator committed its treasury to full compensation (reimbursement)
notes: Researched directly on 2026-10-16 (the batch notes could not reach it); release times not published in the sources read.

name: Hyperbridge token gateway (Ethereum and three other chains)
release_shares: unbacked mint of about 1 billion bridged DOT sold into thin pools (about 108 ETH); escrowed assets released from a related gateway contract (about 245 ETH) hours earlier; per-chain shares not found
failure_basis: a forged message passed the gateway's proof verification (missing bounds check) and the gateway minted and released against it
pause_what: bridging paused on the four affected chains (no time found)
recovered_note: none recovered; the operator committed a token allocation to cover residual losses (reimbursement)
notes: Press dates the event 2026-04-13; release times not established.

name: Verus-Ethereum bridge (Ethereum contract), July 2026
release_shares: 100% from the Ethereum bridge contract (ETH, tBTC, USDC, USDT, EURC, MKR, scrvUSD, DAI) in one transaction
failure_basis: the Ethereum contract paid out against a proof of an export output whose totals and backing it did not check
ack_channel: no operator statement found as of 2026-10-16
pause_what: first of two notary self-revocations on the Ethereum contract (no halt flag set); no notarization after 03:41:47 UTC and no import after the release
pause_source: onchain: Ethereum bridge contract transactions (research batch_M)
recovered_note: none reported (no freeze, recovery address or bounty offer by 2026-07-29)
notes: Second event on the same bridge after E48.

name: Oraichain EVM cross-chain transfer path (unbacked ORAI)
release_shares: unbacked native ORAI realized through DEX pools, IBC transfers and exchange deposits
failure_basis: unbacked native ORAI issued through the network's EVM cross-chain transfer path; root cause not published
pause_what: network halted; bridges, cross-chain routes and interfaces restricted
recovered_note: none confirmed; about 3.9M ORAI at two exchanges subject to freeze requests; unbacked balances burned in the restoration
notes: Mint transactions not identified; the first movement of minted ORAI was at 23:37:27 UTC on 08-08, so lags from the release cannot be computed. Scope is a judgment (an in-protocol transfer path).

name: Harmony cross-shard transfer path (unbacked ONE on shard 0)
release_shares: unbacked native ONE in six cross-shard credits; realized through exchanges, DEX pools and bridges
failure_basis: the destination shard credited replayed cross-shard receipts without a source debit
outflow_source: postmortem: https://x.com/harmonyprotocol/status/2088078119269978281 (first unbacked credit at shard-0 block 92,730,036)
pause_what: the network's bridge to other chains paused; a patched release deployed at 06:30 UTC stopped further credits as validators upgraded; shard 0 later halted and rolled back
recovered_note: unbacked balances removed by the rollback (not value already moved off chain); exchange freezes undisclosed
notes: Not the 2022 Horizon bridge (E14). Scope is a judgment: an in-protocol transfer between shards.

name: Maya Protocol pools (swap outbounds from Bitcoin vaults)
release_shares: 20.83 BTC left the protocol's Bitcoin vaults as swap outbounds
failure_basis: accounting flaws inside the protocol (false missing-outbound detection, uncapped compensation credit) inflated one pool
pause_what: global halt of external-chain observation set through the protocol's parameter mechanism (MAYAChain block 17,978,570); trading on one chain halted at 17:54:13 UTC
pause_source: onchain: MAYAChain parameter history (research batch_M) ; press: https://cointelegraph.com/news/maya-protocol-1-7m-exploit-network-halt
limit_in_force: outbound delay for large outbounds (threshold 100,000 CACAO, 10,000 CACAO per block, at most 200 blocks) and an automatic solvency halt
recovered_note: none reported; a co-founder pledged 0.2M to the pools (reimbursement)
notes: About 8.87M CACAO stayed with the initiating address on MAYAChain and is not in the amount.

name: Nomic-Osmosis IBC route (unbacked nBTC vouchers)
release_shares: 40.65 unbacked vouchers minted on Osmosis in one block; 18.0 exchanged for real BTC collateral in a pool and moved off chain, 22.65 converted later and frozen
failure_basis: the origin chain's transfer code emitted valid packets without an escrow debit; the destination minted the vouchers
ack_channel: X post by the destination chain (@osmosis); no statement by the origin chain found
pause_what: the BTC pool set inactive on Osmosis, voucher transfer quotas set to zero, and the remaining converted balance frozen by an emergency upgrade; the issuance itself was 74 days earlier
limit_in_force: no transfer rate limit on the voucher on 2026-06-25 (quotas added 2026-07-15); the pool's static cap on the voucher's share (35%)
recovered_note: 22.65 converted BTC frozen on Osmosis by an emergency upgrade (2026-09-07/08), not yet transferred; 18 BTC moved off chain not recovered
notes: DefiLlama dates the record at the disclosure (2026-09-09); the unbacked issuance was 74 days earlier. The shortfall was detected only when the origin chain stopped on 2026-09-07.

name: SingularityNET Ethereum-Cardano bridge, FET converter (Ethereum)
release_shares: 100% of the FET held by the converter (backing FET issued on Cardano)
failure_basis: the bridge's conversion-authorizer key, under outside control, signed a release of the converter's full balance
pause_what: affected wallets and the converter deactivated (announced); the same authorizer route kept releasing other tokens through other converters until about 04:38 UTC on 09-20
limit_in_force: none on releases (per-call limits of 100 to 1,000,000 FET applied only to deposits)
recovered_note: none reported
notes: DefiLlama names it Fetch.ai; the route was the SingularityNET bridge. Releases of other tokens through the bridge's other converters on 09-20 are not part of this record.

name: Payy Network rollup contract (Ethereum USDC reserve)
release_shares: 100% from the rollup contract's USDC reserve
failure_basis: the pinned proof verifier accepted an invalid burn proof and the rollup paid it from reserves
pause_what: all network transactions paused (announced); the contract has no pause function; settlement stopped after 09:30:35 UTC
recovered_note: none reported
notes: Settlements came about every five hours; the second payout came five hours after the first.

name: NEAR Intents BSC treasury
release_shares: 100% USDT from the BSC treasury that backs assets bridged into the intents system
failure_basis: undisclosed flaw in the deposit and withdrawal interaction with the intents contract; the treasury honored the resulting withdrawals
pause_what: services stopped after automated outlier detection (detection time not given); deposits and withdrawals on 11 networks kept unavailable about 12 more hours; ordinary treasury withdrawals stopped on-chain after about 08:36 UTC
limit_in_force: automated outlier monitoring that pauses the system; no per-transaction or per-period cap on treasury withdrawals reported
recovered_note: full amount returned by the recipient, announced 2026-10-02 after a 48-hour deadline
notes: the operator's detailed report was not found as of 2026-10-16.

name: QANplatform QANX bridge (Ethereum and BSC reserves)
release_shares: QANX reserves of the bridge contract: Ethereum 50.3% (two releases), BSC 49.7% (one release); each call took the whole balance less a 2% fee
failure_basis: the deployer key, generated with a weak vanity-address tool and set as the unlimited withdrawal signer, was recovered by an outside party and signed all releases
pause_what: none: the bridge contract has no pause function; releases ended when the reserves were empty; exchanges paused QANX trading and the operator withdrew DEX liquidity
limit_in_force: per-signer, per-transaction amount cap in the bridge code; the signing key's cap had been set to the maximum value at deployment
recovered_note: none reported; the operator reissued the token from a pre-event snapshot (reimbursement)
notes: Value per release is the 2M headline figure split by released QANX. The second Ethereum release came 39 minutes after the operator's first post.

name: Rubic RBC/BRBC token bridge (Ethereum and BSC reserves)
release_shares: Ethereum bridge: 34.05M RBC, its whole balance (99.8%); BSC bridge: 54,402.58 BRBC, its whole balance
failure_basis: the admin key holding the bridge's owner role, under outside control, lifted the bridge pause and released its full reserves
pause_what: none after the event (the Ethereum bridge was empty); a pause in force since 2022-10-31 was lifted by the same owner key before the release
limit_in_force: none (owner-only release function with a replay check; no cap or delay; the pause switch was held by the same owner role)
recovered_note: none reported
notes: Value split between the two releases by the press figure (the BSC release was about 2,000 USD).

name: Poly Network (LockProxy contracts on 11 chains), July 2023
chains: Ethereum, BSC, Polygon, Heco, OKC, Avalanche, Metis, Arbitrum, Optimism, Fantom, Gnosis
release_shares: escrow: 58 forged releases from the Ethereum LockProxy carried almost all realized value; unbacked or pre-allocated supplies released on 10 other chains, mostly unsellable
failure_basis: relay-chain consensus keys, taken through a trojan in the build environment, signed forged headers; target chains released altered amounts
pause_what: Paused event on the Ethereum cross-chain manager; the operator shut down the manager contracts on each chain
recovered_note: none reported; token teams pulled DEX liquidity
notes: Bulk of the Ethereum releases at 18:47:47 to 18:58:59 UTC (17 releases) and 20:16:35 to 20:16:47 UTC (39 releases); value not placed per release beyond the five largest enters as an interval over the Ethereum window. SoK's internal discovery time is 7 h.

name: SaitaChain XBridge (Ethereum custody contract)
chains: Ethereum (BSC named by DefiLlama, not verified)
release_shares: Ethereum custody contract (users' locked tokens and lister-deposited liquidity); three tokens, one withdrawal each
failure_basis: a listing function let any caller overwrite a token's lister record, and the new lister withdrew the custody balance
pause_what: the custody proxy put into maintenance mode
recovered_note: none reported
notes: Per-token USD values not given; the value enters as an interval over the three releases. Alternative scope bridge_liquidity_or_relayer;

name: XLink bridge operated by ALEX Lab (BSC endpoint)
release_shares: 100% from the BSC endpoint; withdrawn by a third party that placed its withdrawal ahead of the initiating party and later returned the assets; about 5M on the Ethereum endpoint stayed locked
failure_basis: the deployer key, obtained by an outside party through a deceptive message, upgraded the bridge endpoint proxies to code that released the reserves
pause_what: bridge paused (announced); on Ethereum the operator changed the endpoint's ownership before any withdrawal
recovered_note: returned on 2024-05-15 by the third party that withdrew the BSC endpoint's assets (reportedly for a 10% bounty)
notes: BSC release time not read on chain (one analysis gives 16:44:03 on 2024-05-14 without a time zone). The same key moved assets out of a non-bridge vault on Stacks (not counted).

name: Ronin bridge v1 (Ethereum gateway), March 2022
release_shares: 100% from the Ethereum v1 gateway (173,600 ETH and 25.5M USDC)
failure_basis: five of nine validator keys (four of the operator's, one of a partner organization reached through a stale signing allowlist) signed two withdrawals
pause_what: Paused() on the Ethereum gateway five minutes before the first post; the network's DEX also halted; ordinary user withdrawals had continued until 15:22:07 UTC and the event surfaced when a 5,000 ETH user withdrawal could not be paid
recovered_note: more than 30M seized by law enforcement and industry partners (announced 2022-09-08; 5.7M returned to the operator in 2024); a further 40M frozen by law enforcement (2024); users reimbursed by the operator (not counted)
notes: No public alert before the operator's post (SoK: nobody noticed for 6 days). The relaunched bridge (2022-06-28) added value tiers, human review above 10M USD and a 50M USD daily withdrawal limit.

name: Harmony Horizon bridge (Ethereum and BSC managers)
release_shares: Ethereum about 97.8M (ETH, ERC-20 and BUSD managers); BSC about 1.8M (640,000 BUSD found; the rest, likely BNB, not located)
failure_basis: two of four multisig owner keys (the operator's operational signers) confirmed the unlock transactions
pause_what: Ethereum-side multisig threshold raised from 2 to 4 of 4 owners, so the exposed keys alone could no longer release; 'stopped the Horizon bridge' announced at 23:13:54 UTC; between 15:28 and 18:00 UTC the same two keys still executed ordinary small user unlocks
recovered_note: none reported; bounty and retention offers went unanswered
notes: The first submissions (13,100 ETH) at 10:55 to 11:01 UTC were not confirmed; the fourth, at 11:05:24 UTC, was. No independent alert before the operator's thread was found.

name: Nomad token bridge (Ethereum BridgeRouter escrow)
release_shares: 100% from the Ethereum BridgeRouter escrow; no release on other chains (operator)
failure_basis: message receivers treated unproven messages as proven (a zero root was pre-confirmed at initialization)
pause_what: all five message receivers on Ethereum unenrolled by watcher-signed transactions, 66 s after the last release; the escrow was already nearly empty; later calls reverted
limit_in_force: 30-minute optimistic window on new message roots (no amount or rate cap)
recovered_note: returned voluntarily by participants under a 10% bounty (over 37M by 2022-08-17; about 38.8M by 2022-11-11), distributed through the relaunched bridge
notes: Hundreds of addresses copied the first transactions. Coinbase's end time of 05:49 UTC reads as 00:05:49 UTC, the last release found in chain data.

name: BSC Token Hub (BNB Beacon Chain to BSC bridge)
release_shares: 2M BNB released from the hub's pre-allocated native supply on BSC in two transactions; about 430M stayed on the recipient address when the chain halted
failure_basis: the hub's proof verification accepted forged deposit proofs
pause_what: BSC block production halted by validators (last block 21,962,149; next block at 05:31:10 UTC on 10-07); block intervals lengthened from about 22:03 UTC
recovered_note: about 6.5M USDT frozen by the issuer; the BNB left on the recipient address (about 430M) was immobilized by the halt and later validator action
notes: Release times measured from BSC logs (incidents/03_onchain_bsc_tokenhub.py): 18:26:46 and 20:43:18 UTC, matching Rekt; the deployment note's 18:58:14 UTC is not a hub release. An independent post at 20:33:54 UTC flagged the 900K BNB lending position without identifying an unauthorized release.

name: Orbit Bridge (Ethereum vault)
release_shares: 100% from the Ethereum vault (DAI, WBTC, ETH, USDC, USDT)
failure_basis: validators signed six withdrawals that reused nonces of earlier small deposits at inflated amounts; the operator states that no keys were taken and that the contract worked as designed
ack_channel: X post (@Orbit_Chain), later deleted and reposted at 07:39:20 UTC
first_alert_by: independent analyst (X post; an earlier deleted post at 21:43:36 UTC)
pause_what: Ethereum vault deactivated by the policy admin (withdrawals and deposits require activation), 56 min after the last release
recovered_note: none reported; about 48M moved through a mixer in June 2024
notes: Correction to the earlier chain-data selection: the 0.012 WBTC transfer at 20:40:35 UTC was a legitimate withdrawal later replayed at 230.879 WBTC; the first unauthorized release is 30.095 ETH at 20:52:47 UTC (below 1% of value, so reported as preliminary). The operator learned of the event at 22:05 UTC through its validator channel.

name: Ronin bridge (Ethereum gateway), August 2024
release_shares: 100% from the Ethereum gateway
failure_basis: an upgrade left the gateway's minimum operator vote weight at zero, so withdrawals passed without operator signatures
ack_channel: X post by a co-founder of the operator (first official account post 12:51:01 UTC)
pause_what: Paused event on the Ethereum gateway (through the operator's pause-enforcer contract), 3.6 min after the second release
limit_in_force: per-transaction lock threshold for manual review (4,000 WETH; 2,000,000 USDC) and a daily limit on unlocked withdrawals (4,500 WETH; 2,500,000 USDC)
recovered_note: returned the same day by the two releasing parties (ETH by 15:36 UTC, USDC by 17:38 UTC); the operator paid a 500K bounty
notes: The faulty upgrade took effect at 08:48:47 UTC, 48.6 min before the first release. An independent alert came at 10:25:02 UTC, after the pause.

name: Anyswap (later Multichain) V3 router liquidity pools
release_shares: router liquidity pools: Ethereum 89.1% (MIM and USDC), BSC 9.5%, Fantom 1.4%; each release took the pool's whole balance
failure_basis: the router's MPC key was reconstructed from two signatures that shared a nonce; releases were signed with it
release_side_source: onchain: research batch_I (pool balances zero after the release blocks on Ethereum and BSC)
pause_what: no pause found: each release emptied its pool; the MPC key was rotated on 2021-07-11 (about 14:50 to 14:56 UTC) with a 48-hour delay before taking effect
recovered_note: none reported; the operator refilled the pools (reimbursement)
notes: DefiLlama's target type 'CEX' does not fit. No public alert before the operator's post was found.

name: ChainSwap per-token bridges (Ethereum custody, BSC mapped tokens)
release_shares: independent forged releases on both sides (not a mint redeemed against an escrow): Ethereum custody releases of 29 tokens and mints of two BSC-native tokens; BSC mints of 14 mapped tokens and custody releases of two; shares not published
failure_basis: release contracts accepted receive signatures from unregistered signers, gated only by a per-signer quota
outflow_source: onchain: Ethereum blocks 12,801,461 to 12,801,621 and BSC blocks 9,042,270 to 9,042,351 (research batch_I)
pause_what: mapped-token contracts on BSC frozen to filter out the recipients (announced); releases had ended at 19:50:41 UTC
limit_in_force: per-signer quota refilling over time (default 1% of the cap per day)
recovered_note: 1,060,356 USDT at the recipient address frozen by the issuer (2021-07-13; destroyed 2021-10-19, reissue not found); the operator reissued tokens and compensated projects (reimbursement)
notes: Separate from an earlier, smaller ChainSwap event on 2021-07-02 (0.8M, below the universe threshold by DefiLlama's amount). DefiLlama's 2021-11-07 record (E08) is the same event. Value enters the path as one interval over the Ethereum window (BSC releases ran 19:17:15 to 19:21:18 UTC, inside it).

name: THORChain Ethereum vaults (observer credited deposits never made), 15 July 2021
release_shares: 100% from the protocol's Ethereum vaults (ETH and ERC-20 pool assets) through router outbounds
failure_basis: the Ethereum observer read the outer call value instead of the router deposit and credited deposits that were never made
ack_channel: Telegram announcement channel (first X post 23:21:04 UTC)
pause_what: network halted by node operators (announced); router outbounds stopped after about 19:44 UTC apart from three stragglers, so the halt probably took effect shortly after
limit_in_force: none (the outbound delay for large outbounds was proposed on 2021-07-28 and merged on 2021-09-02)
recovered_note: none reported; about 700 ETH of pending outbounds purged before signing (did not leave); the treasury covered pool losses (reimbursement)
notes: The operator's post-mortem treats it as the first of two router events that month. Value enters the path as one interval over the release window (per-release values not summed).

name: THORChain Ethereum vault (refunds against a fake deposit event), 22 July 2021
release_shares: 100% from one protocol vault on Ethereum through router outbounds; six assets, one release each
failure_basis: the Ethereum observer accepted a deposit event created through a fake router and vault, then refunded real assets
pause_what: ETH chain and trading halted (announced); no router outbound to anyone after the last release
limit_in_force: none (the outbound delay for large outbounds was proposed on 2021-07-28 and merged on 2021-09-02)
recovered_note: none reported; the treasury subsidised pool providers (reimbursement)
notes: The operator's post-mortem treats it as the second of two router events that month; the releases came 94 to 167 s after the trigger calls.

failure_basis: the origin-side deposit path recorded a wrapped-native deposit without receiving the tokens
pause_what: bridge halted (time not found); reopened 2022-02-08
recovered_note: none found
